transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the production plan for the next window. We need to cover 240 Model X motor drives and 120 Model Y motor drives. I'm aware we currently have 450 power modules released for use, with additional units sitting in quality-hold. Before I make any allocation decisions, I need to hear from each of you on your areas: process engineering, quality status on those held modules, logistics readiness, and product compliance. I'll need a complete picture before I sign off on the plan and issue dispositions for every scheduled order.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important from my engineering BOM review. Each Model X drive requires exactly 2 power modules and each Model Y drive requires exactly 1 power module. I completed this review after the latest engineering change but haven't yet entered the revised quantities in the planning system, so the system may still be showing outdated figures.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my quality-hold inspection findings. I inspected the quality-hold area and found that exactly 150 of the held modules can be recovered after a 6-hour controlled bake followed by insulation testing. I documented this in a local inspection worksheet, but it hasn't yet been attached to the material record. So if we proceed with the bake and testing process, we could potentially have 450 currently released modules plus up to 150 recovered modules available — 600 total — for this production window.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share my customer shipment confirmations. I received email confirmations that the Model X order may ship as 180 drives on Friday and 60 drives on Monday, while the Model Y customer requires all 120 drives on Friday. I haven't updated the shipment board with this yet, but it's critical for the production and shipment planning.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share a critical compliance requirement from my destination review. Every Model Y drive must have serialized power-module traceability and a lot-specific compliance certificate before shipment. I completed the review for the export destination but have not yet added the requirement to the dispatch checklist. This means all 120 Model Y drives need these compliance documents attached before they can ship on Friday.
transcript.speaker: A5
